subject: general
question: Which of the following can be used for purification of water?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Alum.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alum**, also known as **aluminium sulfate.**
 
• It is added to water in order to destabilize the mud particles suspended in it.
 
• This process is known as **coagulation. **
 
• Alum helps in purifying water by aluminium which coagulates the mud particles.
 
• It has a high charge on the aluminium ion **(Al+3).**
 
• It helps the small particles of suspended solids to group together until they are of such size that they sink and can be removed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Alum is a type of compound that is very useful in daily life that you find in the grocery store for pickling and in baking powder.
 
• It is also used in leather tanning, as an ingredient in aftershave and as a treatment for fire-proof textiles.
 
• The alum used for purifying water is known as **potash alum.**
 
• Its chemical formula is **KAl(SO4)2.**
 
• It is a combination of double sulphate of **potash and aluminium.**
